# copick match pytom

<span class="source-badge source-badge--pytom-match" title="Provided by the copick-pytom-match plugin">pytom-match</span>

*Find particles by template matching with pytom-match-pick.*

??? info "Plugin command — copick-pytom-match"
    This command is provided by the **[copick-pytom-match](https://github.com/copick/copick-pytom)** plugin, not copick core. Install it to make this command available:

    ```bash
    pip install git+https://github.com/copick/copick-pytom.git
    # pytom-match-pick in its own environment, e.g.:
    conda create -n pytom -c conda-forge python=3.12 cupy cuda-version=12.6
    conda run -n pytom pip install "pytom-match-pick==0.14.*"
    ```

    See the [plugin system](../index.md#plugin-system) guide for details.

## Usage

```bash
copick match pytom [OPTIONS]
```

## Description

Find particles in copick tomograms by template matching with pytom-match-pick.

Each tomogram is matched against a template on the GPU by pytom-match-pick, and the peaks of the score map
become copick picks with orientations and scores (the LCCmax of each peak). The template is rescaled to the
tomograms' voxel size once; the mask is generated from the copick object's radius unless one is given.

pytom-match-pick runs as a separate program from its own environment (it needs cupy and a CUDA GPU). It works
on files, so every tomogram is written to a scratch directory as MRC first; the scratch files are removed when
a run ends, also after an error or a SIGINT/SIGTERM.

Every run needs its tilt-series metadata, from exactly one source: tilt angle files (or a tilt range) with
optional defocus and dose files, a RELION5 tomograms.star, a Warp XML per run, or the run's copick tilt series
(with copick versions that have tilt series). File options take '{run}', which is replaced by each run's name.

## URI Format

```text
Tomograms:     type@voxel_spacing
Picks:         object_name:user_id/session_id
Segmentations: name:user_id/session_id@voxel_spacing
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|--------|------|---------|-------------|
| `-c, --config` | path | — | Path to the configuration file. |
| `--tomogram, -t` | text | **required** | Tomogram URI to match in, type@voxel_size (e.g. 'wbp@10.0'). |
| `--run-names, -r` | text · multiple | — | Specific run names to process (default: all runs). Repeatable; pass -r once per run. |
| `--output, -o` | text | — | Picks URI, object[:user[/session]]; the object must be in the configuration. [default user/session: pytom/1] |
| `--maps` | text | — | Also store the score map as tomogram MAPS and the angle-index map as MAPS-angles (at the input voxel size), so that 'copick match pytom-extract' can extract again without matching. |
| `--template` | file | **required** | Density map of the particle (MRC), at a voxel size no larger than the tomograms'. Its contrast must match the tomograms' (see --invert). |
| `--template-voxel-size` | float range | — | Voxel size of the template map in Angstrom. [default: from its MRC header] |
| `--box-size` | integer range | — | Pad the template to this cubic box (voxels); pytom only enlarges boxes. |
| `--invert / --no-invert` | boolean flag | `False` | Invert the template's contrast: a positive density against dark particles, without a CTF. |
| `--mirror / --no-mirror` | boolean flag | `False` | Mirror the template (wrong-handed maps). |
| `--center / --no-center` | boolean flag | `False` | Centre the density by its centre of mass. |
| `--template-low-pass` | float range | — | Low-pass the map to this resolution (Angstrom) before downsampling. [default: twice the tomogram voxel size] |
| `--prepared-template` | boolean flag | `False` | Use --template as it is: cubic and already at the tomogram voxel size. |
| `--mask` | file | — | Mask (MRC) with the template's box. [default: generated] |
| `--mask-radius` | float range | — | Radius of the generated mask, Angstrom (x semi-axis of an ellipsoid). [default: the copick object's radius] |
| `--mask-radius-minor1` | float range | — | y semi-axis of an ellipsoidal mask, Angstrom (with --mask-radius-minor2). |
| `--mask-radius-minor2` | float range | — | z semi-axis of an ellipsoidal mask, Angstrom (with --mask-radius-minor1). |
| `--mask-sigma` | float range | `1.0` | Gaussian fall-off of the generated mask's edge, voxels; 0 for a hard edge. |
| `--non-spherical-mask` | boolean flag | `False` | The given --mask is not a sphere (doubles the run time). Implied by an ellipsoidal mask. |
| `--particle-diameter` | float range | — | Particle diameter in Angstrom; sets the angular step (Crowther criterion). [default: twice the copick object's radius] |
| `--angular-search` | text | — | Angular step in degrees, or a .txt file of ZXZ Euler angles in radians; overrides the diameter's sampling. |
| `--z-symmetry` | integer range | `1` | Rotational symmetry of the template around its z-axis. |
| `--volume-split` | <integer range integer range integer range> | `(1, 1, 1)` | Split each tomogram into X Y Z pieces, for GPU memory or defocus-gradient correction. |
| `--search-x` | <integer range integer range> | — | Search only voxels START to END (exclusive) along x. |
| `--search-y` | <integer range integer range> | — | Search only voxels START to END (exclusive) along y. |
| `--search-z` | <integer range integer range> | — | Search only voxels START to END (exclusive) along z. |
| `--tomogram-mask` | text | — | Segmentation URI (name:user/session[@voxel_size]) of a per-run search mask; voxels outside it are not searched or extracted. The voxel size defaults to the tomogram's. |
| `--low-pass` | float range | — | Low-pass filter tomogram and template to this resolution, Angstrom. |
| `--high-pass` | float range | — | High-pass filter tomogram and template, Angstrom (removes gradients). |
| `--spectral-whitening` | boolean flag | `False` | Whiten with the tomogram's power spectrum. |
| `--random-phase-correction` | boolean flag | `False` | Correct the scores with a phase-randomised template (STOPGAP-style). |
| `--rng-seed` | integer range | — | Seed of the phase randomisation, for reproducible scores. |
| `--half-precision` | boolean flag | `False` | Compute the score maps in float16. |
| `--tilt-angles` | text | — | Tilt angle file per run (first column, degrees); '{run}' is replaced by the run name. |
| `--tilt-range` | <float float> | — | MIN MAX tilt in degrees, for a plain wedge when the angles are unknown. |
| `--defocus` | text | — | Defocus in micrometres for all tilts, or a file per run ('{run}'): IMOD .defocus (nm) or one micrometre value per line. |
| `--dose-accumulation` | text | — | File per run ('{run}') with the dose each tilt had received before it (e/A^2). |
| `--voltage` | float range | — | Acceleration voltage, kV (with --defocus). |
| `--spherical-aberration` | float range | — | Spherical aberration, mm (with --defocus). |
| `--amplitude-contrast` | float range | — | Amplitude contrast fraction (with --defocus). |
| `--phase-shift` | float range | `0.0` | Phase-plate phase shift, degrees. |
| `--relion5-tomograms-star` | file | — | RELION5 tomograms.star: pytom reads tilt angles, CTF and dose from it. |
| `--relion5-tomo-name` | text | `{run}` | The RELION rlnTomoName of each run ('{run}' is replaced by the run name). |
| `--warp-xml` | text | — | Warp/WarpTools tilt-series XML per run ('{run}'): pytom reads all metadata from it. |
| `--tilt-series` | text | — | Read tilt angles, CTF and dose from the run's copick tilt series: its type, or 'auto' for the one the tomogram was reconstructed from. Needs a copick with tilt-series support. |
| `--alignment` | text | `auto` | With --tilt-series: the alignment whose sections are used, 'auto' (the tomogram's, else the tilt series' best) or 'none' (all sections). |
| `--tilt-angle-source` | choice (nominal \| refined) | `nominal` | With --tilt-series: the nominal stage tilt angles or the alignment's refined ones. |
| `--per-tilt-weighting / --no-per-tilt-weighting` | boolean flag | — | Weight the wedge per tilt. [default: on with tilt angles] |
| `--tomogram-ctf-model` | choice (none \| phase-flip) | `none` | How the tomograms were CTF-corrected. |
| `--defocus-handedness` | choice (-1 \| 0 \| 1) | `0` | Defocus handedness for defocus-gradient correction (needs --volume-split). |
| `--number-of-particles, -n` | integer range | `1000` | The most particles to extract per tomogram. |
| `--cut-off` | float range | — | Extract down to this LCCmax instead of the estimated false-alarm cut-off. |
| `--number-of-false-positives` | float range | `1.0` | Tolerated false positives of the estimated cut-off; higher extracts more. |
| `--extraction-diameter` | float range | — | Peaks closer than half this (Angstrom) are suppressed. [default: the particle diameter] |
| `--tophat-filter` | boolean flag | `False` | Keep only sharp peaks (tophat transform). |
| `--tophat-connectivity` | integer range | `1` | Connectivity of the tophat transform. |
| `--tophat-bins` | integer range | `50` | Histogram bins of the tophat cut-off estimate. |
| `--ignore-tomogram-mask` | boolean flag | `False` | Extract outside the tomogram mask too. |
| `--gpus` | text | — | Comma-separated GPUs from the allocation (CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES positions or UUIDs). [default: all] |
| `--gpus-per-run` | integer range | `1` | GPUs each tomogram is matched on; pytom splits the angular search over them. |
| `--max-workers` | integer range | — | Runs in flight at once. [default: one per GPU slot] |
| `--scratch-dir` | directory | — | Where pytom's temporary files go; they are always removed. [default: the system temp dir] |
| `--pytom-bin-dir` | directory | — | Directory with pytom-match-pick's scripts. [default: PATH] |
| `--tomogram-input` | choice (auto \| zarr \| mrc) | `auto` | How pytom reads each tomogram: a link to its local copick zarr store (needs a pytom that reads OME-Zarr), an MRC copy in scratch, or 'auto' (zarr when possible). |
| `--report` | file | — | Write a JSON report of every run here. |
| `--overwrite / --no-overwrite` | boolean flag | `False` | Replace existing outputs; without it, runs that have them are skipped. |
| `--debug / --no-debug` | boolean flag | `False` | Enable debug logging. |

## Examples

```bash
# Match ribosomes in every run, with IMOD tilt angles and defocus next to each tomogram
copick match pytom -c config.json -t wbp@10.0 -o ribosome:pytom/1 --template ribosome.mrc \
    --tilt-angles '/data/{run}/{run}.tlt' --defocus '/data/{run}/{run}.defocus' \
    --voltage 300 --spherical-aberration 2.7 --amplitude-contrast 0.07

# Two runs, tilt range only, a hand-made mask, 2 GPUs per tomogram
copick match pytom -c config.json -t wbp@10.0 -r TS_01 -r TS_02 -o apoferritin --template apo.mrc \
    --mask apo_mask.mrc --tilt-range -60 60 --gpus-per-run 2

# Metadata from a RELION5 reconstruction job
copick match pytom -c config.json -t denoised@7.84 -o ribosome --template ribosome.mrc \
    --relion5-tomograms-star Tomograms/job007/tomograms.star

# Keep the score maps, then extract again with a stricter cut-off
copick match pytom -c config.json -t wbp@10.0 -o ribosome --maps ribosome-scores --template ribosome.mrc \
    --tilt-range -60 60
copick match pytom-extract -c config.json --maps ribosome-scores@10.0 -o ribosome:pytom/2 --cut-off 0.25
```

## See also

- [`copick match pytom-extract`](pytom-extract.md) — extract particles again from maps stored with --maps
- `copick convert picks2seg` — paint the picks as a segmentation

## Notes

Needs pytom-match-pick 0.14 or newer: --pytom-bin-dir or COPICK_PYTOM_BIN_DIR point at its scripts.
Scratch space is about (2 x GPUs per run + 3) tomogram-sized files per run in flight.
The exit status is non-zero when a run fails.
